title: Dan Grissom and the entertaining Lunceford band
summary: Grissom sang ballads while the others did rhythm tunes; Joe Thomas also sang, and the band was good to watch.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: -- were talking about Dan Grissom and what the vocal quartet did.

Yes, Dan was really the the real vocalist in the group. He sang most of the ballads, and we did the little rhythm, the jump tunes, the rhythm tunes, the rest of us. Of course, Sy Oliver, as mentioned, Willie Smith and Eddie Tompkins, they weren't the only guys who sang tunes and myself, because Joe Thomas, the tenor man, he sang them, quite a few of the little rhythm things also.

So Lunceford had an abundance of guys doing things of this sort, and it was a good entertaining band, and this counted a lot, you know, with people, because visually they were good, and the band played good, you know.
